propwash.trick.tab.title: Freestyle
propwash.trick.tab.help: Detects %1$s freestyle tricks in nine families while you fly – from flips and power loops to Matty variants, dives, Sbang combos and 3D tricks. Points and combo appear discreetly in the OSD (element "Tricks"), score and best combo in the flight stats. Search and filter above, hover a trick for an explanation and a short video, click it for the step-by-step tutorial.
propwash.trick.mode.auto.tooltip: On for Freestyle 5″, Whoop and Cinewhoop, off for race and long-range frames.
propwash.trick.mode.on.tooltip: Always on, whatever the frame. Tricks never count during a race or GPS Rescue.
propwash.trick.mode.off.tooltip: No detection, no points, no OSD messages.
propwash.trick.tab.rules: Combo: land the next trick within %1$s s and the multiplier grows (×1.5, ×2 … up to ×%2$s). Tricks flown straight into each other without settling form a chain and earn %3$s. Repeats are worth less, flying close to blocks and a clean recovery earn a style bonus. A crash or disarm costs the combo bonus.
propwash.trick.tab.state_idle: Counts from the next matching flight
propwash.trick.type.flip.desc: A full turn on the pitch axis, forwards or backwards. Counts from about 250°.
propwash.trick.type.double_flip.desc: Two flips in one go without stopping.
propwash.trick.type.triple_flip.desc: Three flips in one go without stopping.
propwash.trick.type.roll.desc: A full turn on the roll axis, left or right. Counts from about 250°.
propwash.trick.type.double_roll.desc: Two rolls in one go without stopping.
propwash.trick.type.triple_roll.desc: Three rolls in one go without stopping.
propwash.trick.type.snap_roll.desc: Stick in the corner: roll and pitch at full rate at the same time, so the drone tumbles over a slanted axis – like a snap roll in aerobatics.
propwash.trick.type.corkscrew.desc: A slow roll with throttle on while you keep flying: the drone screws itself along its line (barrel roll). Every extra turn counts.
propwash.trick.type.rewind.desc: Turn past upside down and straight back the same way, as if the video ran backwards – a half roll and back, or a whole flip rewind.
propwash.trick.type.juicy_flick.desc: Flick forwards into a half flip until you are upside down, then a half roll back upright: you end up looking back where you came from.
propwash.trick.type.rubiks_cube.desc: Half flip, full roll, half flip in the same direction – or another quick mix of half flips and rolls on alternating axes.
propwash.trick.type.power_loop.desc: Throttle up and pitch back through a whole vertical loop, usually over an obstacle, then fly on in the same direction.
propwash.trick.type.matty_flip.desc: A full flip with a punch while you face backwards or upside down, which turns your flight around: you end up flying back the way you came.
propwash.trick.type.split_s.desc: Half roll onto your back, then pull through a half loop downwards: reverses direction and loses height.
propwash.trick.type.immelmann.desc: The opposite of a split-S: half loop upwards, then a half roll upright – reverses direction and gains height.
propwash.trick.type.yaw_spin.desc: A full turn on the yaw axis without flying a curve.
propwash.trick.type.double_yaw_spin.desc: Two yaw spins in one go.
propwash.trick.type.inverted_yaw_spin.de: Upside down, a full turn on the yaw axis, then back upright. Every extra turn counts.
propwash.trick.type.trippy_spin.desc: Spinning on the yaw axis upside down while you drop or circle around a point. Every extra turn counts.
propwash.trick.type.mctwist.desc: Half flip onto your back, a full yaw spin, then finish the flip in the same direction – named after the skateboard trick.
propwash.trick.type.inverted_hang.desc: Hang upside down without turning for at least 0.9 s. Longer is worth more.
propwash.trick.type.knife_edge.desc: Roll onto your side and hold a straight line for at least half a second. Longer is worth more.
propwash.trick.type.dive.desc: Nose down and drop at least 12 m fast and steep, then catch it. Every metre over 10 m counts.
propwash.trick.type.orbit.desc: Circle around a point with the nose pointing inwards, once per full circle.
propwash.trick.type.gap.desc: Fly fast through a gap at most two blocks wide or high without touching it. Narrower is worth more.
propwash.trick.type.proximity.desc: Fly fast within a metre of blocks beside or above you. Closer and longer is worth more.
propwash.trick.type.eject.desc: The Sbang basic move: tip hard, punch full throttle and snap straight back to level – the drone shoots off flat.
propwash.trick.type.sbang.desc: Sbang with no dead space: an eject plus at least two quick reversals (split-S, Juicy Flick, rewind …), at most 0.8 s apart. Bonus on top.
propwash.trick.type.funky_split.desc: A split-S done parallel to the obstacle: half roll onto your back, half flat spin (yaw) upside down, then upright – you end up looking back.
propwash.trick.type.shinobi.desc: Dex combo: a split-S or funky split straight into a Rubik's Cube, then a Matty flip out. Bonus on top of the three tricks.
propwash.trick.type.guillotine.desc: Climb high, dive straight down and flip out just above the ground, catching the dive. From 8 m drop; higher is worth more.
propwash.trick.type.side_trippy.desc: Circle tightly around a point while lying on your side: the horizon stands vertical and spins. One full lap; every extra lap counts.
propwash.trick.type.inverted_flight.desc: 3D mode only: fly or hover upside down on reverse thrust without falling – at least 1 s. Longer is worth more.
propwash.trick.type.tic_toc.desc: 3D mode only: at least four half flips back and forth, holding upside down on reverse thrust. Every extra half flip counts.
propwash.trick.tab.family.tooltip: Shows only the tricks of one family.
propwash.trick.type.anti_matty.desc: The Matty flip backwards: over an obstacle, throttle off, a full backflip, then level out with throttle – you fly back the way you came, tail first.
propwash.trick.type.half_matty.desc: Half roll to inverted, then the second half of a Matty flip forward with throttle: you carry on tail first, looking back.
propwash.trick.type.power_matty.desc: A Matty flip with an extra flip: throttle off, one and a half front flips, then keep pitching with throttle until you fly back tail first.
propwash.trick.type.split_s_540.desc: One and a half rolls to inverted, then pull through like a Split-S: reverses direction and loses height.
propwash.trick.type.splitback.desc: A Split-S with an extra backflip: half roll to inverted, a full backflip, then pull through downwards.
propwash.trick.type.flip_rewind.desc: A full flip or roll and straight back the same way – like a video playing in reverse.
propwash.trick.type.segmented.desc: Half a flip or roll, stop upside down for a moment (0.4–0.9 s), then finish in the same direction.
propwash.trick.type.vanny_roll.desc: While flying forward, yaw 180° quickly, do a full roll while moving backwards, then yaw another 180° the same way to face forward again.
propwash.trick.type.coin_drop.desc: Cut throttle and drop while spinning upright around the yaw axis – like a falling coin. Every extra turn counts.
propwash.trick.type.tornado.desc: Roll around your own axis in a steep nose-down dive. Every extra turn counts.
propwash.trick.type.backwards_dive.desc: Fall with the nose up: throttle off, tilted back, sink fast for at least 12 m, then recover.
propwash.trick.type.hammerhead.desc: Pull up steeply, yaw the nose over at the top, dive back down and recover – the stall turn from aerobatics.
propwash.trick.type.maverick_loop.desc: A loop over an obstacle with the camera looking forward the whole time: the drone only tilts a little and never goes inverted.
propwash.trick.type.power_flip.desc: A power loop with a flip at the top – backwards or forwards – then finish the loop.
propwash.trick.type.power_roll.desc: A power loop with a full roll at the top, then finish the loop.
propwash.trick.type.inverted_360_power_l: A power loop with a full inverted yaw spin at the top, then finish the loop.
propwash.trick.type.side_loop.desc: Approach sideways and fly a loop over the obstacle using roll instead of pitch.
propwash.trick.type.barani.desc: Half a power loop, a 180° inverted yaw at the top, then a Matty flip back under the obstacle – you end up looking back.
propwash.trick.type.immelmatt.desc: Combo: an Immelmann straight into a Matty flip, at most 0.8 s apart. Bonus on top of both tricks.
propwash.trick.type.wall_ride.desc: Glide along a wall or ceiling on your side – at most 1 m away, without touching it.
propwash.trick.type.reverse_knife_edge.d: Knife edge backwards: on your side, tail first in a straight line for at least half a second.
propwash.trick.type.inverted_hover.desc: 3D mode only: hover upside down on the spot with reverse thrust for at least 1 s, barely moving. Longer scores more.
propwash.trick.type.power_loop_3d.desc: 3D mode only: a full loop on reverse thrust – also as an outside loop downwards, with the top facing out.
propwash.trick.type.flip_3d.desc: 3D mode only: a flip where you switch to reverse thrust while upside down instead of dropping. Every extra flip counts.
propwash.trick.type.roll_3d.desc: 3D mode only: a roll where you switch to reverse thrust while upside down instead of dropping. Every extra roll counts.
propwash.trick.type.side_trippy.aka: Self side trippy, caged side trippy
propwash.trick.tutorial.text.approach_ho: Hover calmly at a safe height. In acro mode the drone does not level itself – keep pitch and roll centred.
propwash.trick.tutorial.text.approach_cr: Fly straight ahead at a steady pace with the drone tilted forward a little. Some speed makes the trick cleaner.
propwash.trick.tutorial.text.approach_fa: Come in fast and straight with the drone tilted well forward. Level out just before the trick.
propwash.trick.tutorial.text.approach_sl: Approach slowly with the drone only slightly tilted forward.
propwash.trick.tutorial.text.approach_cl: Punch the throttle to climb, then cut it: the drone keeps rising for a moment and almost stops at the top.
propwash.trick.tutorial.text.approach_si: Approach sideways: tilt the drone to the side so it travels across its nose.
propwash.trick.tutorial.text.approach_3d: 3D mode on: throttle centred means no thrust, below the centre the motors spin in reverse. Approach calmly.
propwash.trick.tutorial.text.exit_level: Centre the sticks, catch the drone with throttle and fly on calmly. The trick counts once the drone is stable again.
propwash.trick.tutorial.text.entry_punch: Give a short punch of throttle: the drone climbs and has room for the trick.
propwash.trick.tutorial.text.half_roll_i: Low throttle and roll fully to one side: half a roll onto your back.
propwash.trick.tutorial.text.roll_out_up: Roll half way back upright, then catch the drone with throttle.
propwash.trick.tutorial.text.pull_up_loo: Lots of throttle and pitch back: the drone pulls up and backwards into the loop.
propwash.trick.tutorial.text.finish_loop: Then finish the loop as usual with pitch back and throttle.
propwash.trick.tutorial.text.pull_throug: Throttle and pitch back to pull half a loop downwards. The direction reverses and you lose height.
propwash.trick.tutorial.text.tip_over_do: At the top pitch forward until the nose points steeply down.
propwash.trick.tutorial.text.pull_out_ba: Pull out in time with pitch back and plenty of throttle.
propwash.trick.tutorial.text.knife_bank: Roll quickly until the drone stands vertically on its side.
propwash.trick.tutorial.text.knife_back: Roll the other way back to level.
propwash.trick.tutorial.text.eject_punch: Tip pitch hard forward and punch full throttle: the drone shoots forward.
propwash.trick.tutorial.text.eject_snap: Immediately snap pitch back to level and drop the throttle – the drone glides away flat.
propwash.trick.tutorial.text.half_flip_r: Pitch forward until upside down and pull the throttle below centre: reverse thrust.
propwash.trick.tutorial.text.reverse_thr: From vertical, throttle below centre: upside down the reverse thrust pushes instead of letting the drone fall.
propwash.trick.tutorial.text.finish_3d: For the last quarter push the throttle back above centre until the drone is upright.
propwash.trick.tutorial.flip.rotation: Throttle back and pitch fully forward: the drone turns forward once all the way round. Let go of pitch just before it is upright.
propwash.trick.tutorial.double_flip.rota: Throttle back, pitch fully forward and hold: the drone turns forward twice. Let go just before the second turn ends.
propwash.trick.tutorial.triple_flip.rota: Like the double flip, just hold longer: three full turns forward. Gain height first – three flips cost a lot of altitude.
propwash.trick.tutorial.roll.rotation: Throttle back and roll fully to one side: the drone turns once around its long axis. Let go just before it is upright.
propwash.trick.tutorial.double_roll.rota: Roll fully to one side and hold until the drone has turned twice. Keep the throttle low, otherwise it slides away sideways.
propwash.trick.tutorial.triple_roll.rota: Three rolls in a row: roll fully to one side and hold it long. Gain height first and catch the drone right after.
propwash.trick.tutorial.snap_roll.rotati: Push pitch and roll fully into the corner at once: the drone tumbles around a diagonal axis. Let go once it is upright.
propwash.trick.tutorial.corkscrew.rotati: Keep half throttle and roll only halfway: the drone rotates slowly while it keeps flying its line. Two turns, then let go.
propwash.trick.tutorial.segmented.first_: Pitch forward until upside down – only half a rotation.
propwash.trick.tutorial.segmented.pause: Release pitch and hold still upside down for about half a second. Little throttle, or it pushes the drone down.
propwash.trick.tutorial.segmented.second: Pitch forward again and finish the rotation in the same direction.
propwash.trick.tutorial.vanny_roll.yaw_o: While flying forward, yaw fully to one side: the drone turns 180° and keeps flying backwards.
propwash.trick.tutorial.vanny_roll.rotat: Flying backwards, do a full roll: roll fully to one side until the drone is upright again.
propwash.trick.tutorial.vanny_roll.yaw_b: Yaw again in the same direction: another 180° and the nose points forward again.
propwash.trick.tutorial.juicy_flick.half: With throttle, pitch forward until upside down: half a flip.
propwash.trick.tutorial.juicy_flick.flic: Immediately roll half way back upright. Now the nose points back where you came from.
propwash.trick.tutorial.rubiks_cube.firs: Half flip forward: pitch forward until upside down.
propwash.trick.tutorial.rubiks_cube.rota: Straight into a full roll: roll fully to one side, throttle low.
propwash.trick.tutorial.rubiks_cube.seco: Finish with the second half flip in the same direction: pitch forward until upright.
propwash.trick.tutorial.rewind.half_roll: Roll fully to one side: half a roll until upside down.
propwash.trick.tutorial.rewind.reverse: Immediately roll the other way: the drone turns back the same way, as if the video ran backwards.
propwash.trick.tutorial.flip_rewind.rota: A full flip forward: pitch forward until the drone is upright again.
propwash.trick.tutorial.flip_rewind.reve: Without a pause pull pitch back: the flip runs back the same way.
propwash.trick.tutorial.inverted_hang.ha: Pitch forward until upside down with the throttle almost off.
Centre the sticks and hang upside down. The drone falls; at least 0.9 s counts, longer earns more.
propwash.trick.tutorial.power_loop.over_: Hold pitch and throttle: over the top upside down and down the other side until the drone is level.
propwash.trick.tutorial.power_flip.flip: At the top cut the throttle and pull pitch fully back: one full flip before the loop goes on.
propwash.trick.tutorial.power_roll.roll: At the top cut the throttle and roll fully to one side: one full roll before the loop goes on.
propwash.trick.tutorial.inverted_360_pow: Upside down at the top, yaw fully to one side: one full spin around the vertical axis.
propwash.trick.tutorial.maverick_loop.lo: Balance throttle and pitch: the drone flies a full circle, tilts only slightly and never ends up on its back.
propwash.trick.tutorial.side_loop.pull_u: Lots of throttle and roll instead of pitch: the drone pulls up sideways into the loop.
propwash.trick.tutorial.side_loop.over_t: Hold roll and throttle: over the top and down the other side until the drone is level.
propwash.trick.tutorial.barani.pull_up: Pull up into half a power loop with lots of throttle and pitch back.
propwash.trick.tutorial.barani.spin: Upside down at the top, cut the throttle and yaw fully: half a turn around the vertical axis.
propwash.trick.tutorial.barani.finish: With full throttle pitch forward and finish like a Matty flip – at the end you look back.
propwash.trick.tutorial.immelmann.half_l: Throttle and pitch back: half a loop upwards until the drone flies back upside down.
propwash.trick.tutorial.immelmann.half_r: At the top roll half way back upright. You now fly higher in the opposite direction.
propwash.trick.tutorial.immelmatt.half_l: As in an Immelmann: throttle and pitch back, half a loop upwards.
propwash.trick.tutorial.immelmatt.half_r: Roll half way upright and keep a little throttle – at most 0.8 s until the Matty flip.
propwash.trick.tutorial.immelmatt.half_f: Cut the throttle and pitch forward: half a flip until upside down.
propwash.trick.tutorial.immelmatt.punch: Upside down, punch full throttle: the thrust brakes the drone and reverses its direction.
propwash.trick.tutorial.immelmatt.finish: Pitch forward and finish the flip. Immelmann and Matty flip count separately plus the combo bonus.
propwash.trick.tutorial.hammerhead.pull_: From fast flight pull up steeply with full throttle until the nose points straight at the sky.
propwash.trick.tutorial.hammerhead.stall: Cut the throttle and let the drone coast straight up until it nearly stops.
propwash.trick.tutorial.hammerhead.turn: Now yaw fully to one side: the drone turns 180° and the nose points down.
propwash.trick.tutorial.hammerhead.fall: Centre the sticks and let the drone fall back nose first.
propwash.trick.tutorial.hammerhead.pull_: Catch it with throttle and pitch back and fly on in the opposite direction.
propwash.trick.tutorial.matty_flip.half_: Cut the throttle and pitch forward: half a flip until the drone is upside down.
propwash.trick.tutorial.matty_flip.punch: Upside down, punch full throttle: the thrust stops the forward flight and reverses it.
propwash.trick.tutorial.matty_flip.finis: Keep pitching forward until the drone is upright – now you fly back where you came from.
propwash.trick.tutorial.anti_matty.half_: Cut the throttle and pull pitch back: half a backflip until upside down.
propwash.trick.tutorial.anti_matty.punch: Upside down, full throttle: the thrust brakes and pushes the drone back.
propwash.trick.tutorial.anti_matty.finis: Keep pitching back until upright – you now fly back tail first.
propwash.trick.tutorial.half_matty.punch: Full throttle and pitch forward: the second half of a Matty flip – you fly on tail first and look back.
propwash.trick.tutorial.power_matty.flip: Cut the throttle and pitch fully forward: one and a half flips until the drone is upside down.
propwash.trick.tutorial.power_matty.punc: Upside down, punch full throttle while turning on slowly – the flight direction reverses.
propwash.trick.tutorial.power_matty.fini: Finish the flip upright: you fly back tail first.
propwash.trick.tutorial.split_s_540.roll: Roll fully to one side and hold: one and a half rolls until the drone is on its back.
propwash.trick.tutorial.splitback.flip: Upside down, a full backflip: pitch fully back.
propwash.trick.tutorial.yaw_spin.spin: While hovering, yaw fully to one side: the drone spins once on the spot. Keep the throttle so it holds its height.
Hold yaw longer: two full spins on the spot without flying a curve.
propwash.trick.tutorial.inverted_yaw_spi: Upside down, yaw fully: one full turn around the vertical axis, throttle almost off.
propwash.trick.tutorial.trippy_spin.spin: Upside down, throttle almost off and yaw fully: the drone spins twice while it falls.
propwash.trick.tutorial.mctwist.half_fli: Pitch forward until upside down: the half flip.
propwash.trick.tutorial.mctwist.spin: Upside down, yaw fully to one side: a full yaw spin.
propwash.trick.tutorial.mctwist.second_h: Finish the flip in the same direction: pitch forward until upright.
propwash.trick.tutorial.coin_drop.fall: Throttle fully off: the drone drops upright.
propwash.trick.tutorial.coin_drop.spin: While falling, yaw fully: the drone spins like a falling coin. Every extra spin counts.
propwash.trick.tutorial.orbit.orbit: Fly sideways with roll and keep the nose pointing inwards with yaw: the drone circles a point, one full lap.
propwash.trick.tutorial.side_trippy.bank: Roll until the drone lies vertically on its side.
propwash.trick.tutorial.side_trippy.circ: On its side, circle tightly with throttle and pitch: the horizon stands vertical and turns.
propwash.trick.tutorial.dive.dive: Throttle almost off and let the drone dive steeply – at least 12 m, every extra metre counts.
propwash.trick.tutorial.guillotine.dive: Throttle almost off and drop vertically – at least 8 m.
propwash.trick.tutorial.guillotine.flip: Just above the ground keep pitching forward: a flip that you pull out of the dive with full throttle.
propwash.trick.tutorial.guillotine.pull_: Catch it level with full throttle.
propwash.trick.tutorial.tornado.tip_over: Pitch forward until the nose points down, with some throttle: the drone quickly gains speed downwards.
propwash.trick.tutorial.tornado.rolls: In the dive, roll fully to one side: the drone rolls nose down around its long axis, here twice.
propwash.trick.tutorial.backwards_dive.t: At the top pull pitch back: the drone tilts until the nose points up.
propwash.trick.tutorial.backwards_dive.d: Throttle almost off: the drone falls fast, tail first – at least 12 m.
propwash.trick.tutorial.backwards_dive.p: Catch it with pitch forward and plenty of throttle.
propwash.trick.tutorial.knife_edge.knife: Release roll and keep flying straight on its side – at least half a second, longer earns more.
propwash.trick.tutorial.reverse_knife_ed: Yaw fully to one side: the drone turns 180° and flies tail first.
On its side, keep flying straight tail first – at least half a second.
propwash.trick.tutorial.wall_ride.knife_: Glide along the wall on its side – at most 1 m away, without touching it.
propwash.trick.tutorial.gap.pass: Fly fast and straight through the gap between the blocks – at most two blocks wide, without touching. Tighter earns more.
propwash.trick.tutorial.proximity.pass: Fly fast and close past the wall – less than a metre away. Closer and longer earns more.
propwash.trick.tutorial.sbang.split_s: Without a pause, a Split-S: half a roll onto your back and pull through downwards.
propwash.trick.tutorial.sbang.juicy_flic: Right after, a Juicy Flick: half a flip forward, half a roll upright. At most 0.8 s between the tricks.
propwash.trick.tutorial.funky_split.spin: Upside down, yaw to one side: half a flat turn.
propwash.trick.tutorial.funky_split.roll: Half a roll back upright – afterwards you look back where you came from.
propwash.trick.tutorial.shinobi.split_s: First a Split-S: half a roll onto your back and pull through downwards.
propwash.trick.tutorial.shinobi.rubiks_c: Straight into a Rubik's Cube: half flip, full roll, half flip.
propwash.trick.tutorial.shinobi.anti_mat: Out with an Anti Matty: half a backflip, punch upside down and finish upright. All three count plus a bonus.
Keep flying upside down on reverse thrust without falling – at least 1 s, longer earns more.
propwash.trick.tutorial.inverted_hover.i: Hover on the spot upside down on reverse thrust, barely moving – at least 1 s.
propwash.trick.tutorial.tic_toc.first_ha: Half a flip forward and throttle below centre: hold it upside down on reverse thrust.
propwash.trick.tutorial.tic_toc.rock: Alternate half flips back and forward again, switching the thrust each time. At least four halves count.
propwash.trick.tutorial.power_loop_3d.pu: Throttle well below centre (reverse thrust) and pitch forward: the loop runs with the top of the drone facing out.
propwash.trick.tutorial.power_loop_3d.ov: Hold pitch and reverse thrust until the drone has closed the circle and is level again.
propwash.trick.tutorial.flip_3d.entry: With some throttle, pitch forward – the first quarter turn.
propwash.trick.tutorial.roll_3d.entry: With some throttle, roll to one side – the first quarter turn.
